gen_risks.description: Low institutional capacity and lack of World Bank fiduciary experience in newly established ADISA and MIPA may lead to procurement and financial management delays.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a dedicated PMU in ADISA staffed with qualified FM and procurement specialists funded via TA/PPF, supported by CFCU during transition and targeted Bank training.
gen_risks.evidence: Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations...

gen_risks.description: Ambitious reform timelines and compressed implementation schedules across multiple ministries and agencies may result in missed project deadlines.
gen_risks.mitigation: Utilize the Prime Minister's Delivery Unit to actively track implementation milestones, unblock inter-ministerial barriers, and provide just-in-time technical assistance.
gen_risks.evidence: The compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk, which is mitigated by the project’s span and incentives to deliver up to 2020.

gen_risks.description: Institutional and civil service resistance to ceding front-office customer service functions to ADISA/CSC may hinder back-office process re-engineering.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement a comprehensive change management and internal communications program, complemented by high-level leadership from the Inter-Ministerial Public Services Committee.
gen_risks.evidence: Ministries, agencies and individual civil servants may not welcome ceding the front office function to CSC. Bureaucratic resistance could stifle efforts to improve back-office functions.

gen_risks.description: Over-reliance on digital e-services and centralized urban CSC facilities may marginalize or reduce service access for poor, elderly, rural, and vulnerable populations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish functional outreach points for assisted digital access, preserve non-digital information channels, and maintain decentralized local service windows.
gen_risks.evidence: There is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery, such as online services or high-end urban CSCs, will diminish access...

gen_risks.description: Complex inter-ministerial coordination and delays in legislative approval of the proposed Omnibus legislation could stall legal process re-engineering.
gen_risks.mitigation: Drive inter-agency alignment via the Technical Inter-Ministerial Committee and the Prime Minister-chaired IPSC, while bundling legal amendments into a single Omnibus bill.
gen_risks.evidence: Inter-sectoral reforms, especially those that involve more than a dozen government agencies, necessarily entail complex coordination.

gen_risks.description: Paper-based archives, un-digitized legacy registers, and missing national identification numbers across agencies present technical barriers to system integration.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide specialized TA and ICT advisory support for data cleaning, register digitization, software/hardware architecture, and integration with NAIS interoperability platform.
gen_risks.evidence: Seven institutions encompassed by the proposed project have no IT system in place. Entire business processes are performed manually and the data registers are kept in paper form.

gen_risks.description: Failure or delay in meeting disbursement-linked indicators (DLIs), particularly the prerequisite global DLI#5, will block results-based loan disbursements.
gen_risks.mitigation: Prioritize early completion of the PDO baseline survey and Reform Policy Document approval under PPF funding to satisfy DLI#5 early in implementation.
gen_risks.evidence: The disbursements under the results-based financing (RBF) part of the loan are contingent upon the borrower achieving the agreed results...

gen_risks.description: Construction of the new Citizen Service Center (CSC) facility in Tirana may cause localized environmental, noise, dust, waste, and safety impacts.
gen_risks.mitigation: Mandate compliance with the site-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) in construction contracts and assign PMU/consultant oversight for environmental monitoring.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential environmental impacts that are associated with new construction include dust and noise, waste generation, material supply, use of machinery on site...

gen_risks.description: Inadequate government budget allocations for post-project operating costs, system maintenance, and software licenses could compromise long-term sustainability.
gen_risks.mitigation: Incorporate recurrent O&M expenditure planning into the financial management monitoring framework and the government's multi-year fiscal budgeting.
gen_risks.evidence: Ongoing operating costs are expected to include licenses and system operation and maintenance. To continue efficiency improvements once services have been automated...

gen_risks.description: Low digital literacy and modest national internet penetration (60%) could result in low public adoption of online transactional e-services.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct public awareness and education campaigns, deploy call center support, and provide assisted access at local government points and internet cafes.
gen_risks.evidence: ...modest levels of internet penetration at only 60 internet users per 100 people in 2013 (WDI).

gen_risks.description: Inaccurate administrative reporting and poor process definitions by agencies may obscure real service delivery delays and corrupt practices.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement proactive Citizen Feedback Mechanisms (SMS/calls) and independent third-party user surveys to validate administrative data against citizen experiences.
gen_risks.evidence: The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed within the required six days...

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
